Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: target margin, approval days, slow-client days, hour cost, capacity and the days that count as a warning.

List your team on Team and your clients on Clients, then add each project on Projects with its client, lead designer, fee type, fee, FF&E budget and dates. Days late, days to handover and the FF&E check fill in.
Set Phase templates once for each project type: standard weeks, share of hours and the approval gate of every phase. The Project Timeline calculator and the settlement calculator read them.
Add the phases of each project on Phases with planned and actual hours. Mark a phase Done and type the date it finished: days late and the timing check update.
Log every request on Client approvals with the date you asked and the date the client answered. Read Client response speed to see which clients are slow.
Record each change on Change orders and each decision on Decisions log. The running approved total per project and the revised-later flag fill in.
Log time on Time entries and read Project hours and Project profitability: hours used, overrun, margin, margin share and margin per hour for every project.
Keep Rooms, Milestones, Site visits, Project risks, Handover packs and Cancelled and paused up to date.
Use the 14 calculators to plan a timeline, price a change order, forecast a margin, plan an approval, recover an overrun, forecast the handover and settle a cancelled project.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open the messaging app with the text ready.
Run the Weekly project review every Monday and read Projects Dashboard and Charts for late projects, waiting approvals, hours and margins.

FF&E schedule with trade cost, client price and margin
One row per item: vendor, quantity, list price, trade discount and mark-up; unit cost, trade cost, client price, margin and the approval, lead-time and margin checks fill in by themselves.
Room budgets against what is specified
One row per room with its approved budget; the specified total, what is left, the share used, the over-budget check, waiting items and the specification deadline fill in by themselves.
Project budgets against what is specified
One row per project with the FF&E budget, trades budget, fee and contingency; the specified FF&E, what is left, the variance, the reserve left and the freeze check fill in by themselves.
Category budgets against what is specified
One row per project and category with its share of the FF&E budget; the budget in money, the specified total and the variance fill in by themselves.
Item, sample and budget approvals with waiting time
One row per approval asked of a client about items, samples or budgets; days to approve, the answer-by date, days waiting and the speed check fill in by themselves.
Substitutions with price, margin and lead-time effect
One row per substituted item: the new item, vendor and cost; the old vendor, price change, client price change, share and lead-time change fill in by themselves.
Alternatives per item with a recommended option
One row per option offered for an item: vendor, trade cost, client price and lead time; the price difference to the current choice, margin share and the recommended flag fill in by themselves.
Finish and sample log with days to receive
One row per sample or finish asked from a vendor; days to receive, days waiting, the on-time state, the client decision date and all phones fill in by themselves.
Vendors with trade discount, lead time and what is specified
One row per vendor or trade account; items specified, value specified, trade value, margin earned and margin share fill in by themselves from the FF&E schedule.
Mark-up rules by category with what is really used
One row per item category: standard and minimum mark-up and the price rounding step; margin, items, value and the number of items under the minimum fill in by themselves.
Vendor discount tiers and what was earned

One row per vendor tier: the order value from which an extra discount applies; the trade value ordered, whether the tier is reached, the discount earned and what is still needed fill in by themselves.
Room and sqm benchmarks against your own rooms
One row per room type: typical size, budget per sqm and items per room; your own average size, budget per sqm and items per room fill in by themselves from the rooms you budgeted.
Item library of reusable items with trade and standard price
One row per reusable item with vendor, list price, trade discount and lead time; the trade cost, standard mark-up, standard client price and how often it was used fill in by themselves.
Allowance in the proposal against what is specified
One row per project: the FF&E allowance agreed with the client; rooms, specified total, the gap, the gap share and the verdict fill in by themselves.
Dimensions, quantities and fabric metres per item
One row per item that needs sizes: width, depth, height in cm, quantity and fabric metres for one; the item, project, total fabric metres and volume in cubic metres fill in by themselves.
Lighting schedule with watts, dimmers and cost
One row per lighting fitting in a room: quantity, watts, dimmer and switch group; total watts, unit cost, cost and the dimmer check fill in by themselves.
Fabric and upholstery schedule with metres and cost
One row per upholstered or sewn item: fabric, metres for one, quantity, vendor and lead time; total metres with waste, cost, the ready date and the order check fill in by themselves.
Items needing a decision with days waiting
One row per item that is stuck: the issue, who owns it, when it was raised and when it is due; the item, value, days waiting and the decision check fill in by themselves.
Projects with FF&E budget and the items in them
One row per project with type, lead, status and FF&E budget; items, rooms over budget and the phones fill in by themselves.
Change orders on items with the running total
One row per change order raised on items or rooms; the client, the running approved total of the project and the share of the budget fill in by themselves.

Client: your room items are ready
Hello, the item specification for {room} in {project_name} is ready to approve. It stands at {specified} against a budget of {budget}. May we go through it together?
Client: please approve an item by
Hello, please approve or choose {description} by {due_date}. Without your answer the delivery date may move.
Client: items in a room need approval
Hello, a reminder: {items_waiting} items in {room} still need your approval. The specification is due on {spec_due}.
Client: your room budget is attached
Hello, your room budget for {room} is attached. The approved budget is {budget} for {sqm} sqm, and {specified} is specified so far.
Client: the specification is over budget
Hello {client}, the specification for {project_name} is {variance} against the budget. Options to bring it back are inside the report. May we talk this week?
Client: two alternatives for an item
Hello, here are alternatives for {description}: {option} from {vendor} at {client_price} per piece, lead time {lead_weeks} weeks. Which one do you prefer?
Hello, your sample of {material} has arrived at the studio. Please see it by {decide_by} so the order is not delayed.
Hello, we propose a substitute for {description}: {new_item}. Reason: {reason}. The price changes by {client_change} and the lead time by {lead_change} weeks. May we go ahead?
Client: approved items go to order
Hello {client}, thank you. {items_approved} approved items of {project_name} are released to order. The specification is frozen on {freeze_on}.
Hello, please confirm the quantity of {description}: {qty} pieces, {width} by {depth} cm. We order on your confirmation.
Client: your finish choices are due
Hello, your finish choice for {material} in the {room} is due on {decide_by}. The vendor needs your decision to hold the lead time.
Client: the price of an item changed
Hello, the price of {description} changed. The new price effect for you is {client_change}. We will not order before you agree.
Hello, please quote {description}, quantity {qty}, for our project {project}. Please include the trade price, the lead time and the delivery cost.
Hello, please send a sample of {material} for project {project}. We need it by {decide_by} if possible. Thank you.
Vendor: confirm price and lead time
Hello {contact}, please confirm our trade discount of {trade_discount} and your current lead time of {lead_weeks} weeks for the coming projects.
Hello, {description} from your range is no longer available to us. Which alternative do you recommend, and at what trade price and lead time?
Vendor: please confirm the fabric stock
Hello, please confirm that you have {total_metres} metres of {fabric} from one batch. We plan to order by {order_by}.
Hello, a project quantity enquiry: {qty} pieces of {description}. Is there an extra discount for this quantity or for a single delivery?
Owner: a room is over its budget
Hello, {room} in {project_name} is over its budget by {over_by}. Specified {specified} against {budget}. Please review before the client sees it.
Owner: a project is above its budget
Hello, the specification of {project_name} is {variance} against the approved budget. Budget check: {budget_check}. Reserve left: {contingency_left}.
Owner: an item margin is too low
Hello, the margin on {description} in {project_name} is {margin_share}, under the target. Mark-up {markup_pct}. Please check the price.
Owner: items wait for the client
Hello, {description} (value {value}) has waited {days_waiting} days for a decision on project {project}. Decision check: {dec_flag}.
Owner: the weekly review is ready
Hello, the weekly specification review is ready. {name}: {items_count} items, {specified} specified against {ffe_budget}, {rooms_over} rooms over budget.
Hello, please complete the specification for {room} in {project_name}. It is due on {spec_due}. {items_waiting} items still wait for approval.
Lead: an item still needs a vendor
Hello, {description} in {room} ({project_name}) still has no vendor. Please choose one so we can price it.
Lead: the substitute needs your check
Hello, please check the substitute for {description}: {new_item}. Price effect {price_change}, lead time change {lead_change} weeks.
Assistant: request samples for a room
Hello, please request samples for {room} in {project_name}. The specification is due on {spec_due}.
Assistant: approved items ready to order
Hello, the approved items of {project_name} are ready to order: {items_approved} items. The client has approved them.
